mapper.select: SELECT park.*, carport.number AS carport_name FROM park LEFT JOIN carport ON park.carport_id = carport.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO park (number, type, remark, carport_id, area) VALUES (#{number}, #{type}, #{remark}, #{carportId}, #{area})
mapper.update: UPDATE park SET number = #{number}, type = #{type}, remark = #{remark}, carport_id=#{carportId}, area=#{area} WHERE id = #{id}
